title: Race and Ethnicity in Sarasota County
text: Explore racial and ethnic demographics across census tracts in Sarasota County, Florida, based on the 2022 5-year American Community Survey (ACS). Use the controls in the top-right to switch between demographic layers, and hover over any tract to see detailed population shares.
